summary: Ondas Inc. filed an 8-K primarily to disclose the filing of a prospectus supplement for the resale of 297 shares of common stock by certain stockholders, issued as consideration in the prior acquisition of World View Enterprises Inc. This is a routine securities law compliance filing for an unregistered sale of equity under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D. No new transaction, capital return, or special situation is being announced. The filing also includes a legal opinion from Snell & Wilmer L.L.P. regarding the legality of the shares. No deal terms or events triggering a special-situations category are present.
